agent_runs.agent_sql:
SELECT
    h.holding_id,
    p.party_id,
    p.full_name
FROM normalized.life_participant lp1
JOIN normalized.life_participant lp2
    ON lp1.holding_id = lp2.holding_id
    AND lp1.party_id = lp2.party_id
    AND lp1.participant_sk <> lp2.participant_sk
JOIN normalized.holding h
    ON lp1.holding_id = h.holding_id
JOIN normalized.party p
    ON CONCAT('PARTY#', lp1.party_id) = p.party_id
WHERE lp1.is_deleted = false
    AND lp2.is_deleted = false
GROUP BY h.holding_id, p.party_id, p.full_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.participant_sk) > 1
agent_runs.executed_sql:

    h.holding_id,
    p.party_id,
    p.full_name
FROM normalized.life_participant lp1
JOIN normalized.life_participant lp2
    ON lp1.holding_id = lp2.holding_id
    AND lp1.party_id = lp2.party_id
    AND lp1.participant_sk <> lp2.participant_sk
JOIN normalized.holding h
    ON lp1.holding_id = h.holding_id
JOIN normalized.party p
    ON CONCAT('PARTY#', lp1.party_id) = p.party_id
WHERE lp1.is_deleted = false
    AND lp2.is_deleted = false
GROUP BY h.holding_id, p.party_id, p.full_name

agent_runs.agent_sql:
SELECT
  p.party_id,
  p.full_name,
  SUM(h.market_value) AS total_market_value,
  ARRAY_JOIN(ARRAY_AGG(DISTINCT ip.product_name), ', ') AS product_names
FROM normalized.party p
JOIN normalized.coverage c ON CONCAT('PARTY#', c.party_id) = p.party_id
JOIN normalized.holding h ON c.holding_id = h.holding_id
LEFT JOIN normalized.holding_subaccount hs ON hs.holding_id = h.holding_id
LEFT JOIN normalized.invest_product ip ON hs.fundcode = ip.fundcode
WHERE p.is_deleted = false
  AND h.is_deleted = false
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.full_name
ORDER BY total_market_value DESC
LIMIT 10

agent_runs.message: Explain what the coverage table represents.
agent_runs.answer: The `coverage` table stores one row per benefit attached to a policy — Base, Rider, or Optional coverage — linking a specific holding (policy) to the insured party and its product, along with financial details like face amount, cash value, and surrender value. The 20 sample rows show a mix of coverage types (Base, Rider, Optional) across various statuses (Active, Inactive, Paid-Up, Lapsed) and products (VUL, UL, TERM10/20/30, WHOLE, IUL).
